claim_one_line: THE TUBE AT k = 3 (P-739; R80-9): WHY THE MESHER STOPPED IS FOUND, AND ITS VALUE IS NOT RESOLVED AT THESE GRIDS. B1847's search for the fibre's monodromy looks for entries between -40 and 40; at k = 3 the monodromy is [[109, -71], [-66, 43]] (trace 152, the word's own), so the search finds nothing and the mesher stops at an assertion with no message. Both diagnoses on record (the lattice condition; the two unlabelled translation checks) were wrong, and B1854 carries a dated correction. Solved exactly (at k = 1 and 2 the same matrices as the search; k = 4 and 5 too), the mesher runs to the end at k = 3, but the level surfaces nearest the core are off in their determinant by 3 to 8 per cent and do not come closer from grid 120 to 160: main's value neither confirms nor contradicts the web seat's sealed 6.069. P-739 stays open. 0 of 19.
